target_customer: Battery manufacturers, battery-as-a-service providers, EV OEMs and fleet operators
problem: Battery health and lifespan are hard to see and predict in electric vehicles, which leads to downtime and early battery replacement.
business_model: B2B SaaS analytics platform (pricing not found)
product_category: Battery observability and predictive analytics software

founders.name: Khushboo Shrivastava
founders.background_notes: YC page describes her as an award-winning data scientist with over 6 years in automotive enterprise products including car-sharing and fleet software; employers and education not listed.

founders.name: Santanu Mondal
founders.background_notes: YC page lists 6 years at General Motors and product lead experience in EVs, battery management and charging; a UN Women piece spells the name Shantanu.

investors: The Company Lab Sustainable Mobility Accelerator

competitors.name: TWAICE
competitors.what: Battery analytics software using digital twins for EV and energy storage battery health
competitors.traction_then: customers reportedly include Audi and Daimler
competitors.funding_then: raised $26M Series B in May 2021, about $45M total

technical_complexity.rationale: Predictive battery models from real-time telemetry need battery modeling expertise plus data engineering across vehicle platforms.

defensibility.rationale: Models improve with fleet data and OEM integrations are sticky, but TWAICE was far ahead in funding and automotive customers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: OEMs and funded analytics vendors built similar capabilities; no acquisition of Coulomb AI found.

market_need_then: EV adoption in India and worldwide was rising in 2021, with a need to track battery state of health for warranties, resale and fleet uptime; TWAICE's $26M raise in May 2021 showed investor interest.

branding.domain_note: Uses coulomb.ai; acquisition details not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, mission driven and technical but accessible, with phrases like 'Digital Identity for your Batteries' and 'Boost your Battery Performance & Life'.

brand_strength.rationale: Name references the unit of electric charge, fitting for batteries, but is shared with a different company, Coulomb Litech, and no press on the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Coulomb AI was founded in 2021 by a data scientist and an ex-GM battery product lead and joined YC in Summer 2021. Public records show only small aggregator-listed funding, a team of about 10 and continued hiring, with no sale or shutdown found. The company appears alive but small, and traction is not public, so the outcome cannot be judged.
notes: Rounds rest on single databases: Seedtable (125K, 2021-09, YC, Caplight agrees) and CB Insights (about 20K non-equity accelerator money, 2024-01). Totals conflict: CB Insights 150K over 4 rounds, Clera 125K, Foundernest 145K, so rounds are missing or inconsistent. Latka claims no outside funding, which conflicts. Coulomb Litech (Mumbai, 20 crore seed) is a different company. Seedtable fetch blocked (403). battery-tech.net places HQ in San Francisco and lists FortyTwo VC as backer, unverified.
